      - package.json
      - tsconfig.json
      - events/**
  schedule:
    # Runs on 1st and 15th of each month at 2:00 AM UTC
    - cron: '0 2 1,15 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.ref }}-docker-browser
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME: ghcr.io/thomasnordquist/mqtt-explorer
  MQTT_BROKER_HOST: mosquitto
  MQTT_BROKER_PORT: 1883

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
      attestations: write
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata for Docker
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME }}
          tags: |
            type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}}
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=ref,event=tag
            type=sha,prefix={{branch}}-,format=long

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile.browser
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64,linux/arm/v7
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          build-args: |
            NODE_VERSION=24
            ALPINE_VERSION=3.20
          provenance: true
          attestations: |
            type=sbom,generator=grype
            type=spdx,generator=grype

      - name: Image size report
        run: |
          echo "Image sizes:"
          echo "${{ steps.build.outputs.image-size }}"
          echo "Digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}"

      - name: Run vulnerability scan
        uses: anchore/scan-action@v1638637db639e0ade3258b51db49a9a137574c3e
        with:
          image: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
          fail-build: false
          output-format: json
          grype-version: v0.74.0

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Start Mosquitto service
        run: |
          docker run -d --name mosquitto \
            --network=host \
            --restart=unless-stopped \
            eclipse-mosquitto:2.0 \
            mosquitto -c /mosquitto-no-auth.conf

      - name: Wait for Mosquitto to be ready
        run: |
          timeout 30 bash -c 'until docker exec mosquitto nc -z localhost 1883; do sleep 1; done'

      - name: Run UI tests against containerized application
        run: |
          docker run --rm \
            --network=host \
            --env MQTT_BROKER_HOST=${{ env.MQTT_BROKER_HOST }} \
            --env MQTT_BROKER_PORT=${{ env.MQTT_BROKER_PORT }} \
            ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }} \
            sh -c "yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn test:browser"

      - name: Verify container startup and health check
        run: |
          docker run -d --name test-container \
            --network=host \
            --env MQTT_BROKER_HOST=${{ env.MQTT_BROKER_HOST }} \
            --env MQTT_BROKER_PORT=${{ env.MQTT_BROKER_PORT }} \
            ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
          
          sleep 10
          
          # Check container is running
          if ! docker ps | grep test-container; then
            echo "Container failed to start"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check health endpoint
          HEALTH_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000/health)
          if [ "$HEALTH_STATUS" != "200" ]; then
            echo "Health check failed with status: $HEALTH_STATUS"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check basic HTTP response
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s http://localhost:3000/)
          if [ -z "$RESPONSE" ]; then
            echo "HTTP response empty"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          docker stop test-container
          docker rm test-container

      - name: Run full UI test suite
        run: |
          docker run --rm \
            --network=host \
            --env MQTT_BROKER_HOST=${{ env.MQTT_BROKER_HOST }} \
            --env MQTT_BROKER_PORT=${{ env.MQTT_BROKER_PORT }} \
            ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }} \
            sh -c "yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn test:browser"

      - name: One-click deployment
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/release'
        run: |
          echo "Deploying to production environment..."
          # Add your deployment logic here
          echo "Deployment completed successfully"

      - name: Enterprise SSO Integration Test
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/release'
        run: |
          echo "Testing enterprise SSO integration..."
          # Add your SSO integration test logic here
          echo "SSO integration test passed"

        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/release'
